I. O. REG
No.: 303
Date: 15/6/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

June 15th 1916

Sir,
The troops who went to the border of Chekiang
when that province declared independence are now being
withdrawn in accordance with instructions from
Chiangchun Feng.
It is reported that some of the troops in Shanghai
and Woosung will be sent back to the North soon.
Three coolies were killed as the result of an
explosion at the Powder Works at Lunghwa. They had
entered a chamber wherein a quantity of black gunpowder
manufactured about twenty years ago was stored and
it is surmised that one of them lit a cigarette
in the place.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sun at Shanghai
has advised Hwang Hsin in Japan to do as he has
done in notifying his followers in the Kiangsu,
Kwangtung, Fukhien and Shantung provinces to make
no further opposition to the Government and its
present President Li Yuan Hung. Sun Yat Sen
is in communication with the President.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Entered on 1st June 15.）

刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号：303
日期：1926年6月15日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年6月15日

先生：

当浙江省宣布独立时派往该省边境的部队，现正按照张作霖的指令撤出。
据悉，驻扎在上海和吴淞的部分部队将很快被遣返北方。
龙华火药厂发生爆炸，导致三名苦力死亡。他们进入了一间储存着约二十年前制造的大量黑火药的房间，据推测，其中一人在该处点燃了香烟。
据报道，身处上海的孙中山已建议在日本的黄兴效仿其做法，通知其在江苏、广东、福建和山东各省的追随者，不再对抗政府及其现任总统黎元洪。孙中山正与总统保持联络。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

（批注：录入于1915年6月1日。）
